description: Atomic γ-4 send extensions — `<send eventexpr/delayexpr/sendidexpr>` resolve against the datamodel at action time; `<param>` / `<content>` / `<content expr>` / namelist marshal into `_event.data`; `<send idlocation>` writes the resolved sendid back into the datamodel. Outbound `<send>` external transport (HTTP / explicit URL targets / `BasicHTTPEventProcessor`) remains reject-walled for γ-4b. <invoke> remains reject-walled for γ-4a.
